summary: Ran the product smoke check and day-01 regression scenarios on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844), including empty/spaces input, trimming, long titles, rapid adds, keyboard-only use, reload, and back navigation. All flows behaved as described with no console errors. No bugs found; known-bugs list was empty.

scenarios.title: Smoke: page load and chrome
scenarios.notes: Todos heading, New todo field, Add, empty state, Format version 1; no console errors on desktop and mobile.

scenarios.title: Smoke: add two todos in order
scenarios.notes: Add button and Enter both work; field clears; order preserved.

scenarios.title: Smoke: toggle done then undo
scenarios.notes: Checkbox marks done and unticks correctly on both viewports.

scenarios.title: Smoke: delete a todo
scenarios.notes: Deleting the second todo leaves the first; empty message returns when list cleared.

scenarios.title: Smoke: keyboard-only flows
scenarios.notes: Tab/Enter/Space can add, toggle, and delete on desktop and mobile.

scenarios.title: Empty and spaces-only titles rejected
scenarios.notes: Neither empty nor whitespace-only titles create todos.

scenarios.title: 500-character title stays usable
scenarios.notes: Long title adds without horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile.

scenarios.title: Delete middle todo
scenarios.notes: Only the targeted item is removed; neighbors remain.

scenarios.title: Reload and back button
scenarios.notes: Reload clears list as intended; back leaves the page usable with no console errors.

scenarios.title: Mobile regression / no overflow
scenarios.notes: Day-01 mobile repeat of core flows; no horizontal overflow.
